excerpt: Your Guide to Hiring with an Open Work Permit in Canada Published by: Can X Global Solutions Inc. Hiring foreign talent is a key strategy for many Canadian businesses facing labour shortages. Canada’s open work permit system makes it easier for employers to hire skilled workers and allows eligible workers to accept jobs across multiple sectors without the need for employer-specific paperwork.
